# LeafRunsSynthesis.kt — 15 iterations, exponent cap 3, leaves: pending, exponents on both sides, depth 2 from iteration 1

The paper's algorithm with exponents 1..min(k, 3) at iteration k, plus a leaf search on seeds + {v} for each leaf value v and on seeds + {v, w, ...} for every set of up to 2 leaf values from iteration 1 on (see the source). Every search uses the paper's window (m, m²] of the seeds.

Total wall-clock time: **9118.6s** (4 threads)

Primes found: **285** (including the seed 2); **all verified prime**

Gap-free up to **1697** (first missing: 1699); largest 2143; 39 primes missing below it

Found only by leaf searches: **211**
